description: billops 'Demo Users' admin endpoint: GET /api/billops/admin/demo-users guarded by @PreAuthorize(hasAnyAuthority ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN/ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN_SUB), returning per demo-client user email, displayName, authProvider, firstSeen, lastLogin, loginCount, optional lastIp — ALL sourced from user_activity_event LOGIN rows (billops User/AppUser are minimal mappings with no authProvider/lastLoginAt; add NO column). New repo query methods + DemoUserDto + DemoUserLoginAgg projection. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs Client.demo for the findByClient_Demo derived query). Independent of FEAT-002/003.
steps: Create the DTO /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/billops/src/main/java/com/xammer/billops/dto/DemoUserDto.java as a record with fields: String email, String displayName (KEEP — required by AC-28, sourced from AppUser.username; currently equals email), String authProvider, LocalDateTime firstSeen, LocalDateTime lastLogin, long loginCount, String lastIp. Nullability contract: email/displayName never null; authProvider/firstSeen/lastLogin/lastIp null when no LOGIN row; loginCount 0 when none.

Create a Spring Data projection DemoUserLoginAgg (interface with getUserId(), getFirstSeen(), getLastLogin(), getAuthProvider(), getLoginCount()) under /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/billops/src/main/java/com/xammer/billops/dto/ (or .../repository/).

Add `List<AppUser> findByClient_Demo(boolean demo)` to /Users/admin/.../billops/repository/AppUserRepository.java (derived query over AppUser.client @ManyToOne and the new Client.demo). This is the only user-table query the endpoint needs (do not touch billops UserRepository).

Add read methods to /Users/admin/.../billops/repository/UserActivityEventRepository.java: a grouped @Query `List<DemoUserLoginAgg> aggregateLoginsByUserIds(@Param("userIds") Collection<Long> userIds)` selecting e.userId, min(e.createdAt) firstSeen, max(e.createdAt) lastLogin, max(e.authProvider) authProvider, count(e) loginCount from UserActivityEvent e where e.action='LOGIN' and e.userId in :userIds group by e.userId; and `Optional<UserActivityEvent> findFirstByUserIdAndActionOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long userId, String action)` for last IP. Use the literal 'LOGIN'.

Update the now-stale Javadoc so the next reader is not misled: on /Users/admin/.../billops/repository/UserActivityEventRepository.java replace the 'write-only / reads served by xamops-service' note with a line noting it now also serves a read-only LOGIN aggregate for the admin demo-users view (writes still the single ImpersonationTokenController caller); on the billops UserActivityEvent entity /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/billops/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/domain/UserActivityEvent.java replace 'and reads nothing' with a note that BillOps now reads LOGIN rows (aggregate) for the demo-users endpoint, mapping stays column-identical to the xamops copy (no column added, NFR2). Optionally add `public static final String ACTION_LOGIN = "LOGIN";` for readability (a constant, not a column).

Create the controller /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/billops/src/main/java/com/xammer/billops/controller/DemoUsersAdminController.java: @RestController @RequestMapping("/api/billops/admin"), @GetMapping("/demo-users") @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN', 'ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN_SUB')") (copy the exact string from SupportAdminController), returning List<DemoUserDto>. Assembly: users = appUserRepository.findByClient_Demo(true); agg = eventRepository.aggregateLoginsByUserIds(user ids) indexed by userId; per user build DemoUserDto (email, displayName=username; if an agg row exists use its fields + lastIp from findFirstByUserIdAndActionOrderByCreatedAtDesc(id, "LOGIN"); else authProvider=null, firstSeen=null, lastLogin=null, loginCount=0, lastIp=null). No @CrossOrigin.

Add a repository slice test: seed an is_demo client with two AppUser rows and several LOGIN (+ non-LOGIN) events; assert aggregateLoginsByUserIds returns correct min/max/count AND authProvider and ignores non-LOGIN actions; assert findByClient_Demo(true) excludes non-demo-client users; assert findFirstByUserIdAndActionOrderByCreatedAtDesc returns the latest LOGIN row's ip_address; add a zero-LOGIN-rows user case. Add a controller test: @PreAuthorize denies an unauthenticated/under-privileged caller (AC-27) and returns the DTO list for an admin. Place tests under /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/billops/src/test/java/... following existing billops test conventions.
acceptance_criteria: AC-27: GET /api/billops/admin/demo-users requires ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN or ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN_SUB; under-privileged/unauthenticated callers are denied with no weaker guard than peer admin endpoints.

AC-28: the endpoint returns one entry per user of an is_demo=true client with email, display name, auth provider, first-seen (earliest LOGIN), last-login (latest LOGIN), total login count, and optionally last IP, derived from user_activity_event (action='LOGIN') joined to the demo client's users and app_user.
AC-29: the endpoint reflects real stored data — after a new demo login the user's last login and total login count update.
AC-30: the data path adds no column to either UserActivityEvent copy and uses existing billops repositories plus new query methods and a DTO.
AC-35: billops boots against the shared schema with only client.is_demo added; the two UserActivityEvent copies stay column-identical.
verification: From /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host run `mvn test -B --no-transfer-progress -pl billops -am` — module compiles; the repository slice test and the controller @PreAuthorize test pass.
findings: Implemented in billops. FRONTEND CONTRACT: endpoint is GET /api/billops/admin/demo-users (controller DemoUsersAdminController @RequestMapping("/api/billops/admin") + @GetMapping("/demo-users")), guarded by @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN', 'ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN_SUB')"). Returns List<DemoUserDto> (com.xammer.billops.dto.DemoUserDto record) with JSON fields (exact names): email (String, never null), displayName (String, never null; currently equals email because auto-provision sets username=email), authProvider (String, null when no LOGIN row -> omitted/absent in JSON), firstSeen (LocalDateTime, null->absent), lastLogin (LocalDateTime, null->absent), loginCount (long, 0 when none), lastIp (String, null->absent). Frontend must render absent/null fields as em-dash and loginCount 0 as 0. NOTE: Jackson omits null record fields by default in this project config, so the frontend should treat missing keys as null (the controller test asserts .doesNotExist() for the null fields). New types: DemoUserDto, DemoUserLoginAgg (projection), AppUserRepository.findByClient_Demo(boolean), UserActivityEventRepository.aggregateLoginsByUserIds(Collection<Long>) + findFirstByUserIdAndActionOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long,String), UserActivityEvent.ACTION_LOGIN constant. No columns added (NFR2). Verification: `mvn test -B --no-transfer-progress -pl billops -am` -> BUILD SUCCESS, 386 run / 0 failures / 0 errors / 25 skipped. New controller security test DemoUsersAdminControllerSecurityTest ran (6 tests pass: anonymous 401, under-privileged 403, admin+sub-admin get the DTO list incl. zero-LOGIN null/0 contract). New repository slice test DemoUsersRepositoryPgTest is LOBTEXT_TEST_JDBC_URL-gated (skips in the fast suite, like sibling PG tests); it covers findByClient_Demo exclusion, aggregate min/max/count/provider ignoring non-LOGIN, and last-IP finder.
